scope: Bounded reread of seven existing official CN source bodies for nine newly matched Global identities. No broader historical launch audit or current in-game availability check.
method: Each complete public HTML body was read, including unrelated retrospective wording, and searched for target-specific maintenance, launch and acquisition statements. Web extraction succeeded for five; two timed out and were read through direct public HTML retrieval. Direct copies of all seven were retained only in temporary storage.
